open_questions: Wing 1a/3a hold stack (20 -> 30) stays under cargo 40; owner to confirm it is felt but not a courier game.
handoff: Raids softened and delayed, reclaim 5 steps, wing amounts raised (hub reach +3, tax +30/+40, workshops -20). Mining keys kept.

raid_first_cycle.why: no raid before the player has lanes and a base

raid_chance_per_lane.why: 3 lanes: (0.05+0.09)=0.14 per cycle, hard intensity x2 = 0.28, under the cap

raid_take_share.why: 40 percent of one trip (about 16 units, about 240 credits): stings, never ruins

prosperity_reclaim_steps.why: 5 met cycles x 3 needs x 16 = about 240 units, close to the whole Bazaar bill (290): reclaim competes with it

bazaar_wing_wing_2a.why: +30 percent tax (tax is small, wing must be felt)

bazaar_wing_wing_3b.why: +40 percent tax, higher than 2a as it comes later

details.sim: not run (owner instruction: no sim, bots or QA). Numbers reasoned by hand: a lane ship moves 20 units/cycle (cargo 40, 2-cycle round trip), margin about 14/unit, trip cost 60.
